purpose: Teach: サタン/羽生/オスカー/クレア/フォックス/魔物/プリーズ/乞食

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが聖書の解説で「サタンの誘惑」を語って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is explaining Satan's temptations from the Bible to us.
lines.style: Warm, conversational report. Gentle opening. Soft pace. A hint of affectionate amusement at Dad's tangent. Trailing off slightly, as if already anticipating the next topic shift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと羽生結弦選手の演技動画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a video of Yuzuru Hanyu's skating performance with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, immediate. Quick opening attack — he can't wait to share. Eager, unburdened. Each phrase gets a small lift. No hesitation, just pure reporting of something that made him happy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアカデミー賞のオスカー特集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is watching the Academy Awards Oscar special right now.
lines.style: Calm, observational report. Even tone. Steady pace. A gentle commentary on Dad's current absorbed state. Matter-of-fact, with the smallest undertone of 'Dad is doing Dad things again.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクレア・デインズ主演のドラマ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a drama with Dad — it's the one Claire Danes is in.
lines.style: Bright and direct. Quick onset. Pleased with himself for remembering the actor's name. Youthful energy, genuine excitement. Small pauses between ideas but no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが20世紀フォックスの古い映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is watching old twentieth-century Fox films at the moment.
lines.style: Calm report. Steady, slightly rhythmic delivery. A touch of gentle indulgence — this is just what Dad does. Soft breath underneath. Slight trailing quality, like 'and so it goes.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「魔物退治」のRPGプレイしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I played an RPG called Monster Slayer with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, energetic onset. Unburdened joy. Slightly faster pace than his previous lines — games carry more excitement. Clear articulation. Small bright lift on the game title.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「英語の『プリーズ』は丁寧な依頼」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is teaching us that 'please' in English is a polite way to make requests.
lines.style: Calm, reporting tone. Gentle opening. Steady pace. A sense of quiet appreciation for Dad's thoughtful lessons. Slight emphasis on the teaching itself, not the content.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「『乞食』は配慮深く扱う言葉」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that 'beggar' is a word we should treat with thoughtfulness and respect.
lines.style: Earnest, careful delivery. Slower pace than his eager lines — he's processing something important. Soft, sincere opening. Slight weight on 'thoughtfulness.' Gentle, full close on the final word.
